Unmodified `extensions/rv_v` and `LICENSE` from RISC-V International's
[riscv-opcodes](https://github.com/riscv/riscv-opcodes/tree/72b292677715a091a441c9a55f9d62715d3c5ba2),
commit `72b292677715a091a441c9a55f9d62715d3c5ba2`.

The catalog contains 375 encoding entries. Variable `nf` fields include
segment forms; instruction aliases and optional vector extensions are outside
this file. The local test generator supplies operands without changing fixed
encoding bits. This encoding catalog does not replace the V 1.0 semantic spec.
